description: This file implements socket set management functions for reading, writing, and monitoring socket activity with timeouts, including adding sockets to sets, clearing sets, updating timeouts, and performing select operations.

methods.name: SOCKET_SET_Clear
methods.description: Clears all socket sets and sets the maximum timeout.

methods.name: SOCKET_SET_AddSocketToReceiveFrom
methods.description: Adds a socket to the read set with a specified timeout.

methods.name: SOCKET_SET_AddSocketToSendTo
methods.description: Adds a socket to the write set with a specified timeout.

methods.name: SOCKET_SET_UpdateTimeout
methods.description: Updates the socket set timeout to the minimum of current and specified timeout.

methods.name: SOCKET_SET_Select
methods.description: Performs a select call to wait for socket activity, returning number of active sockets or error.

methods.name: SOCKET_SET_IsReadyToWrite
methods.description: Checks if a socket is ready for writing.

methods.name: SOCKET_SET_IsReadyToRead
methods.description: Checks if a socket has data to read.
